Administracion de empresas, identidad y: Company administration, identity and settings of each company.
Permite usar el asistente de IA de la ap: Lets the user use the app's AI assistant. The assistant can only do what the user is allowed to do and asks for confirmation before changing data. What it looks up is sent to Anthropic.
Permite ver quien hizo cada cambio en la: Lets the user see who made each change in the company (user, module, record and date) and export it.
